2607.04683.title: Does It Fail to See or Fail to Know? Attributing Errors in Vision-Language Models
2607.04683.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on visual question answering with high-quality images but struggle when questions require knowledge beyond what is clearly and directly visible. In such settings, uncertainty quantification should not only indicate whether the model is likely to fail but also diagnose why it is uncertain, across dimensions such as perception, entity recognition, and knowledge retrieval. While prior work has focused on individual failure modes in isolation or treated incorrect answers as monolithic failures, we propose a unified framework for disentangling these failure modes and investigate whether pre-generation signals can predict these failure sources. Across a range of datasets and model families, we find a consistent pattern in VLM errors: some failures arise from visual or recognition bottlenecks, while others persist after the relevant entity is identified. Our main finding is that these failure sources can be predicted before decoding: recognition-related failures are best captured by visual-token representations, while failures that remain after recognition are better captured by prompt-conditioned hidden states. This pre-generation signal enables efficient failure-source prediction before the model produces an answer, allowing uncertain cases to be routed to targeted interventions such as image repair, entity recognition support, or external retrieval.
2607.04683.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型（VLMs）在高品質圖像的視覺問題回答中表現良好，但當問題需要超出明顯和直接可見的知識時，它們則會遇到困難。在這種情況下，不確定性量化不僅應該指示模型可能失敗的情況，還應診斷其不確定性的原因，涉及感知、實體識別和知識檢索等維度。雖然先前的研究專注於孤立的個別失敗模式或將錯誤答案視為單一的失敗，但我們提出了一個統一框架來解開這些失敗模式，並調查預生成信號是否可以預測這些失敗來源。在一系列數據集和模型家族中，我們發現VLM錯誤中存在一致的模式：一些失敗源於視覺或識別瓶頸，而另一些則在相關實體被識別後仍然存在。我們的主要發現是這些失敗來源可以在解碼之前進行預測：與識別相關的失敗最適合用視覺標記表示來捕捉，而在識別後仍然存在的失敗則更適合用提示條件隱藏狀態來捕捉。這一預生成信號使得在模型生成答案之前能夠高效地預測失敗來源，從而允許將不確定的案例引導至針對性的干預措施，如圖像修復、實體識別支持或外部檢索。
